protocol: Nested CV: inner stratified 3-fold for all scaling, feature selection and hyperparameter search. Pooled scheme: outer stratified 5-fold (seed 42). LOSO: each fold holds out one whole source.

screening.note: Logistic regression, fast grids (k=500, C in {0.1, 1.0}). Kept for reference; the full run below re-runs every arm with full grids and all models.
